name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Google Ads drove all $1,521.37 in spend over 28 days with 15 conversions, but the lead_drought flag signals a tracking disconnect since zero leads are being recorded in the dashboard. performance.verdict: Spend is live but lead tracking is broken; GBP momentum masked by zero CRM intake ownership.

findings.text: Zero leads recorded across all 28 days despite $1,521.37 spent and 15 Google Ads conversions — dashboard lead pipeline is disconnected from ad platform data.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completed event — speed-to-lead promise is unverified 21 days past deadline.
Dispatch seat (Vivian) vacated 7/7; GHL intake owner unconfirmed — 77 contacts and 41 opportunities created with 0 appointments logged signals active intake leak, not an ads problem.

3-day spend signal (Aug 18–20: $16.06, $21.63, $84.70) is erratic vs prior 3 days (Aug 15–17: $130.18, $9.12, $18.71) — no sustained trend, spend is pacing irregularly against the ~$46/day 7d average.
GBP actions rose 41.18% week-over-week to 105 total (38 calls, 32 directions) but zero of those calls appear in GHL as leads — organic demand is real but untracked.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL lead source mapping and Google Ads conversion import — 15 conversions recorded, 0 leads in dashboard; close gap this week.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 15 conversions on $1,521.37 spend over 28 days, but the GHL dashboard shows zero leads — the two systems are disconnected. Audit the Google Ads conversion action import into GHL and confirm GBP call-tracking numbers are routed as lead sources (38 GBP calls are landing nowhere in the pipeline). Success check: GHL contacts created from paid and GBP sources match platform conversion counts within 20% by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns GHL intake post-Vivian and verify after-hours coverage — 41 opps created, 0 appointments logged is an intake failure, not a lead volume problem.
suggestions.monday_update: Dispatch seat vacated 7/7 and no confirmed replacement has been identified; speed-to-lead automations are pointing at an empty seat. Confirm the named GHL owner (Xavier or Aiman) with Nader, verify their login is active, and confirm after-hours routing is live. Success check: at least 1 appointment logged in GHL within 48 hours of confirmation, and the 0-appointment count begins moving by 2026-08-25.

suggestions.text: Hold all budget increases until intake ownership is confirmed and lead tracking is repaired — scale-back-up gate per SOW remains blocked.
suggestions.monday_update: The SOW scale-back-up gate explicitly blocks raising budgets until dispatch intake is resolved. With zero leads tracked, the booking bot unverified 21 days past its 7/31 deadline, and no confirmed GHL intake owner, there is no defensible basis to increase the ~$42/day current spend. Re-check on 2026-08-28: if lead tracking is repaired and an intake owner is confirmed, surface a budget-raise suggestion at that point.
